major-orders.title: Major Orders
major-orders.description: Major Orders are large-scale strategic objectives issued to the Helldiver community. They can require the liberation or defense of planets, destruction of enemy forces, completion of special operations, or other galaxy-wide objectives within a limited period.

meridian-black-hole.title: Meridian Black Hole
meridian-black-hole.description: The Meridian Black Hole formed after Helldivers injected Dark Fluid into the Terminid Supercolony on Meridia, causing the planet to collapse on June 2, 2184. Initially believed to be a black hole, later research determined the anomaly was actually a wormhole. Following the return of the Illuminate, the Meridian Singularity became central to their plans: Dark Energy harvested during Illuminate invasions was used to move the anomaly across the galaxy, turning the remains of Meridia into a devastating weapon.

the-gloom.title: The Gloom
the-gloom.description: The Gloom is an enormous interstellar cloud of Terminid spores that began emerging from deep Terminid territory in August 2184. The cloud rapidly expanded across multiple planets and sectors, blocking Super Earth from gathering reliable intelligence within its boundaries. Ships and probes entering the Gloom lost communications, while Terminids exposed to its extreme evolutionary conditions developed increasingly dangerous mutations. The Gloom eventually concealed heavily transformed worlds, including Oshaune, which was discovered to have become a Terminid Hive World.

hive-worlds.title: Hive Worlds
hive-worlds.description: Hive Worlds are planets completely infested and terraformed by the Terminids. Beneath their surfaces lie enormous networks of caves containing Terminid nests, hostile organisms, and Spore Lungs believed to produce and sustain the Gloom. Their surfaces are similarly transformed, featuring Terminid structures, spires, and hazardous environments. Oshaune was the first Hive World discovered by Super Earth, while Zagon Prime and Omicron were subsequently identified as Hive Worlds hidden within the Gloom.

the-void.title: The Void
the-void.description: The Void is an unnatural Illuminate interstellar anomaly formed as the final stage of an Illuminate Exostorm. It can engulf entire star systems, blocks conventional observation and signals, and severely disrupts navigation and intelligence gathering.

appropriators.title: Appropriators
appropriators.description: The Appropriators are an Illuminate subfaction composed entirely of Illuminate personnel and machinery rather than Voteless forces. Their deployments feature Illuminate foot soldiers, drones, and piloted constructs.

exostorm.title: Exostorm
exostorm.description: Exostorms are unnatural interstellar meteorological phenomena generated by Illuminate Exospires. They progressively intensify through three classifications, producing extreme planetary weather, lightning, tornadoes, and eventually spacetime fractures and disturbances in the passage of time. A prolonged Class 3 Exostorm can destabilize reality around an occupied planet until the system is engulfed by the Void.

void-gateway.title: Void Gateway
void-gateway.description: The Void Gateway was a Super Earth-controlled connection point between the galaxy and the Void, established on Rirga Bay after scientists discovered that modified Alcubierre Drive warp bubbles could protect vessels from the Void's destructive outer radiation field. A massive Warp Relay Station was constructed to generate a bubble large enough for Super Destroyers and other Super Earth forces to safely enter the anomaly.

void-sector.title: Void Sector
void-sector.description: The Void Sector was a temporary region of the Galactic Map containing planets engulfed by the Illuminate-created Void. The anomaly obscured conventional galactic intelligence and isolated the affected worlds from normal space. Super Earth eventually penetrated the region during Operation Void Piercer, allowing Helldivers and SEAF forces to conduct operations inside it. The Void Sector ceased to exist after the Void dissipated on August 23, 2186.

tcs-plus-breaches.title: TCS+ Breaches
tcs-plus-breaches.description: The TCS+ Breaches are a series of Terminid infestations and attacks affecting planets protected by Super Earth's Terminid Control System+ network. Although the completed barrier was declared capable of permanently preventing Terminid infestation, several protected worlds subsequently experienced renewed Terminid activity. Super Earth attributed some incidents to dissident sabotage. By late August 2186, further breaches included renewed infestation on Brilliance and a Predator Strain assault against Achernar Secundus.

counterdissident-hammer.title: Counterdissident Hammer
counterdissident-hammer.description: Counterdissident Hammer is an ongoing Super Earth campaign launched on August 25, 2186 following renewed Terminid outbreaks within the completed TCS+ containment line. Super Earth attributes the failures to extremist dissident sabotage and has ordered a galaxy-wide counter-dissidence operation while Helldivers respond to Terminid incursions. The opening Dissident Manhunt phase followed a major TCS+ failure on Brilliance and directed Helldivers toward planets identified by the Ministry of Truth as suspected dissident strongholds.
